title: Check Query Plan v1.0
description: A pre-computed semantic-search programme for one QA check, executed against AiPromptEvaluator's search_case_documents tool (CaseDocumentSearchTool.cs). Derived from artifacts/check-coverage-matrix.csv. Each query group corresponds to one matrix row; each group pairs an assertion-side query (worded as the suitability report writes it) with an evidence-side query (worded as the source document writes it), because the tool cannot filter by document category.

primaryCategories.description: Category codes named in the check's Primary Document Categories column.

tool.description: Runtime contract the plan is written against.

parameters.description: caseReference and tenantId default to the loaded case; pass searchText only.

categoryFilterAvailable.description: CaseDocumentStore.SearchAsync filters on tenant_id and case_reference only. categoryCode is returned on each hit and must be applied as a post-filter.

triggerProbe.description: Runs first. Establishes whether the check applies at all, so 'N/A: trigger absent' is evidenced rather than assumed.

triggerField.description: checkTriggers field in the canonical model this probe sets.

decision.description: How group outcomes roll up to the check's three-way finding.

overlayInstruction.description: For overlay checks (CHK-010): what to re-evaluate in the other checks once this one has been decided.

estimatedPassages.description: Upper bound: total queries x resultsPerCall, before de-duplication.

CategoryCode.description: A Client Authority; B Know Your Client; C Meetings & Communications; D Risk, Capacity & Experience; E Existing Plans & Portfolios; F Needs Analysis; G Research; H Solution Design; I Recommendations & Advice.

text.description: The searchText argument, verbatim. Written in the vocabulary of the target document, not the vocabulary of the check — the embedding matches document language.

side.description: Assertion = what the suitability report claims (expect category I). Evidence = what the file holds (expect categories A-H). Either = the phrasing retrieves both.

targetCategories.description: Categories a useful hit should carry. Applied as a post-filter on the returned categoryCode; hits outside this set are context, not evidence.

expectSignals.description: Concrete values or phrases that indicate the query landed. Absence of all of these across every hit means the data point is not in the file.

requirement.description: The 'What to Look For' item from check-coverage-matrix.csv this group answers.

comparison.description: How the assertion side and evidence side are compared once both have been retrieved.

falsePositiveGuards.description: Known ways this comparison produces spurious mismatches (gross vs net, different as-at dates, incompatible provider risk scales).
